AfD party wins state election in Germany's Saxony-Anhalt

The anti-migrant Alternative for Germany (AfD) party has achieved a significant victory in the state election held in Saxony-Anhalt, Germany. Preliminary results indicate the AfD secured the top position in the vote. Ulrich Siegmund, identified as the party's lead candidate and a media-savvy figure, aims to lead the AfD into government in the state. The election saw polls open with predictions favoring the AfD's success.
